evidence.evidenceSnippet: UWA's Library guide says enterprise AI tools have agreements and configurable controls, and that currently only Copilot Chat is approved as an Enterprise AI Tool at UWA. The guide does not state a user population, login path or licence allocation.

UWA’s 2026 student AI guide now states that UWA staff and students must not use DeepSeek in any way, that UWA has blocked DeepSeek on University-managed networks and devices, and that students should avoid using DeepSeek on their personal devices.
The Department of Home Affairs has raised concerns on the safety and security of data shared with the AI tool DeepSeek.
As such, UWA staff and students must not use DeepSeek in any way.
UWA has blocked the use of DeepSeek on all University-managed networks and devices, and students should avoid using DeepSeek on their personal devices.
